Composition & Indication

Esomeprazole 40mg — 28 Capsules (Generic for Nexium®) contains Esomeprazole Magnesium 40 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 28 Capsules at the official 40mg strength. The standard indication is the management of GERD and erosive esophagitis, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Esomeprazole 40mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
